name: browser-use
headline: ReactorUMG - Build UIs with React in Unreal Engine
short_description: ReactorUMG is a plugin for Unreal Engine that enables developers to build UMG game UI and editor UI using React. It benefits game developers and UI designers by streamlining UI development workflows. The plugin connects React's component-based architecture with Unreal Engine's UMG system, allowing for more efficient and maintainable UI code.
author: Caleb196x

sections.overview:
ReactorUMG is an Unreal Engine 5.x plugin that bridges React's component-based architecture with UMG, enabling developers to write game UI and editor tools using native React, TypeScript, and TSX syntax. The plugin supports live preview and hot reload during development, React Hooks, function and class components, and PuerTS scripting for engine interaction. It is particularly suited for building editor extension tools and UI development workflows that benefit from AI-assisted code generation and modern front-end practices like componentization and static type checking. The plugin currently targets editor UI tools and Windows, Android, and Linux platforms for runtime UI.
Build editor utility panels and extension tools with React and TypeScript
Create game UI with live preview and hot reload during development
Generate editor UI quickly using AI-assisted coding workflows
Develop reusable UI component libraries for Unreal Engine projects
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/Caleb196x/ReactorUMG`
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
